findings.text: Event emission target changed from `this` to `this.parent`: when `_actionHandler` exists but `this.parent` is null, the `command:<name>` event is never emitted anywhere, breaking any code listening on the command itself. Failing input: a root command (no parent) with an action handler and a listener for `command:<name>` will never receive the event.

Inconsistent event emission logic: when `_actionHandler` exists the event fires unconditionally on parent (if parent exists), but when no `_actionHandler` exists the event fires only if parent already has listeners. This means adding an action handler changes whether the event can fire at all when parent has no listeners yet.
